gaps.sentence: 'Who broke the window?' the teacher demanded. The teacher demanded ___ the window.
gaps.explanation: 'Demand to know + wh-clause' with statement order; past simple backshifts to past perfect.

gaps.sentence: 'I've already spoken to the insurers,' he reminded me. He reminded me that he ___ spoken to the insurers.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect backshifts to past perfect: had already spoken.

gaps.sentence: They ___ us that the museum had closed early.
gaps.explanation: Tell somebody (that)... — 'told' needs the direct personal object 'us'; 'said' cannot take it.

gaps.sentence: 'What are your plans for the weekend?' he asked. He asked what my plans for the weekend ___.
gaps.explanation: are → were: the copula backshifts like any other verb.

gaps.sentence: She ___ me not to worry about the deadline.
gaps.hint: tell sb not to do sth
gaps.explanation: Only 'tell' takes a personal object + not to + infinitive; 'said me not to' is impossible.

gaps.sentence: 'I'll call you later,' he promised. He promised that he ___ call me later.
gaps.explanation: Will backshifts to would in reported speech.

gaps.sentence: 'Don't forget your tickets,' she said to us. She ___ us to take our tickets.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't forget' maps onto remind + object + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'The road is being resurfaced,' the council said. The council said the road ___ resurfaced.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive (is being resurfaced) backshifts to past continuous passive: was being resurfaced.
